experiment: jungle9 macro DAgger round 1 (student drives, teacher labels, aggregate re-distill)

chain.problem: jungle9 strengthened-init BC (240 teacher eps, 104,206 decisions; offline calibration healthy) scored 0/16 on the checkpoint panel - ALL active losses (median death ~5,330 ticks, 80 on-target shots, score 2,855): the student fights but drifts into deep-chain crisis states absent from teacher data (~434 decisions/ep compounds drift)
chain.intervention: DAgger round 1: 160 student-driven episodes (7 wins, 44,240 teacher-labeled decisions on student-visited states; collector s99081737), merged with the teacher collection (merge s99081738, 148,446 decisions, fire fraction 19.9%), re-distilled with the standard invfreq recipe (BC s99081739; offline calibration still healthy: fire_ratio 1.21, recall 0.82, aim_w3 0.82)
chain.outcome: panel STILL 0/16 - and the failure MODE changed for the worse: median death 4,948 ticks with THREE on-target shots and score 70 (vs 80 shots / 2,855 score for the teacher-only BC). The aggregate BC is functionally never-fire in closed loop.

diagnosis: The never-fire attractor returned THROUGH DATA COMPOSITION: the 44k DAgger rows concentrate exactly on the runtime state distribution, and the model resolved the two-regime dataset by fitting 'states like the ones I visit -> wait/park' strongly enough to suppress firing in deployment, even though the global fire fraction (19.9%) and class weights were nominally unchanged. Offline metrics were blind to it (they average over the mixed distribution). LESSON (campaign rule): a DAgger round that leaves the student 0-win must be treated as POISON for plain aggregation - the label distribution on doomed trajectories teaches avoidance of action, not avoidance of danger. Candidate follow-ups: beta-mixed driving (--teacher-drive-prob ~0.5) to collect near the winning corridor, or curriculum-style anchoring; NOT another plain aggregate round.
pending_control: teacher-through-macro sanity on panel seeds 1494001000/05/10 running at receipt time - if the TEACHER cannot win these panel seeds, part of jungle9's 0/16 is a panel-difficulty property and the gate metric itself needs re-examination; result to be appended as an addendum

evidence.sidecar_agreement: mean exact 0.050 over 160 sidecars (harsh metric: wait rows require exact park-bin equality)
